searchText: Has anyone spent much time thinking about how to build a layer 2 censorship resistant ecommerce payment platform that doesn't require a huge amount of complexity for people doing integrations? I believe at the moment if you wanted to build a censorship resistant ecommerce platform each client would have to run their own Ethereum node, or at least subscribe to something like Infura or QuikNode. Is there a system design that could be implemented today that would make this not necessary? Even if you accept Infura/QuikNode, is it possible/reasonable to build a L2 ecommerce payment platform that doesn't require the user to run their own L2 servers? Paying for stuff online with ETH and paying $10 in transaction fees is not fun, but I also recognize that the vast majority of ecommerce apps out there don't have the skillset/ability to build out/operate/maintain all of the infrastructure necessary for a payment platform. <@456226577798135808> spamming <@!203220829473996800> ^ <@839531346632507432> is a scammer 🔨 So many scammers here Bots, they swarm lots of other crypto servers I'm in too, can't do much about it, we tried Not sure if this is the right place to go for this but I heard there was some work to coordinate a RSA trusted setup ceremony using the Diogenes construction at some point later this year and I was interested in getting involved
